name: mxl_workshop
description: MXL spreadsheet template constructor. 18 operations: create_template, set_cell, format_cells, merge_cells, draw, add_drawing, remove_drawing, read_template, add_named_area, list_named_areas, remove_named_area, insert_rows, delete_rows, copy_rows, insert_columns, delete_columns, copy_columns, check_print_width. They manipulate (or, for read_template, read back) the moxel SpreadsheetDocument model directly. Coordinates are 1-based. check_print_width reads the model alone: whether the print area fits the sheet by width, and which page defaults the answer took. It changes nothing.

operation.description: create_template / set_cell / format_cells / merge_cells / draw / add_drawing / remove_drawing / read_template / add_named_area / list_named_areas / remove_named_area / insert_rows / delete_rows / copy_rows / insert_columns / delete_columns / copy_columns / check_print_width / help

projectName.description: Name of the EDT project to work in

ownerFqn.description: Template owner FQN (Catalog.X / Document.X), or CommonTemplate.X itself

row.description: Cell row (1-based); insert_rows puts the new rows before it, delete_rows removes from it

col.description: Cell column (1-based); insert_columns puts the new columns before it, delete_columns removes from it

fillType.description: set_cell: how the cell is filled - text, parameter or template. A parameter name without fillType is read as parameter.

parameter.description: set_cell: template parameter name. BSL fills it through the area's parameters.

language.description: Language tag for the LocalString content (default 'ru')

areaName.description: Named area name for the named-area operations. The mechanism that loads data from a file reads a template by these: the area name becomes the loaded column name.

areaKind.description: add_named_area: columns (default for a load template), rows, or rect. Bounds come from fromRow/fromCol/toRow/toCol; columns reads the column pair, rows the row pair.

fromRow.description: Merge range from-row; copy_rows: first source row

fromCol.description: Merge range from-col; copy_columns: first source column

toRow.description: Merge range to-row; copy_rows: first target row

toCol.description: Merge range to-col; copy_columns: first target column

count.description: insert_rows / delete_rows / copy_rows / insert_columns / delete_columns / copy_columns: how many rows or columns (default 1)

formatFrom.description: insert_rows: where the new rows take the row format and cell formats from - above (default, and none at row 1), below or none; insert_columns: where the new columns take the column format and cell formats from - left (default, and none at col 1), right or none. Text and parameters are not copied

drawingType.description: add_drawing: Line / Rectangle / Ellipse / Text (RU aliases ok)

beginRowOffset.description: add_drawing: intra-cell offset for begin row (default 0)

beginColumnOffset.description: add_drawing: intra-cell offset for begin column (default 0)

endRowOffset.description: add_drawing: intra-cell offset for end row (default 0)

endColumnOffset.description: add_drawing: intra-cell offset for end column (default 0)

formatIndex.description: add_drawing: format-table index for stroke/fill (default: a fresh empty format)

drawingId.description: remove_drawing: id of the drawing to remove

textPlacement.description: format_cells: how text behaves when it does not fit - auto / cut / block / wrap.

textOrientation.description: format_cells: text rotation in degrees, from 0 to 360. The template stores tenths of a degree, so 90 is written as 900.

rowHeight.description: format_cells: explicit row height. There is no auto-height flag in the model - a row with no explicit height whose cells wrap is what the platform grows to fit the text.

autoColumnWidth.description: format_cells: let the column width follow its content.

columnWidthWeight.description: format_cells: this column's share when the available width is distributed.

border.description: format_cells: line style on every side - None, Solid, Dotted, Double, ThinDashed, ThickDashed, LargeDashed.

borderWidth.description: format_cells: width of the borders this call adds. Defaults to 1.

leftBorder.description: format_cells: line style of the left side.

topBorder.description: format_cells: line style of the top side.

rightBorder.description: format_cells: line style of the right side.

bottomBorder.description: format_cells: line style of the bottom side.

fontName.description: format_cells: font face. A cell with no font yet starts from Arial.

fontSize.description: format_cells: font height in points, greater than 0.

pattern.description: format_cells: fill pattern - WithoutPattern, Solid, or Pattern1 through Pattern17.

pageOrientation.description: format_cells: page orientation, Portrait or Landscape. Applies to the whole template.

scale.description: format_cells: print scale in percent. Applies to the whole template.

copies.description: format_cells: number of copies. Applies to the whole template.

perPage.description: format_cells: pages per sheet. Applies to the whole template.

fitToPage.description: format_cells: scale the sheet to fit the page. Applies to the whole template.

topMargin.description: format_cells: top margin in millimetres. Applies to the whole template.

leftMargin.description: format_cells: left margin in millimetres. Applies to the whole template.

bottomMargin.description: format_cells: bottom margin in millimetres. Applies to the whole template.

rightMargin.description: format_cells: right margin in millimetres. Applies to the whole template.

smallScalePercent.description: check_print_width: print scale below which the answer warns of unreadable type (10..100, default 75). help topic=printWidth says where 75 comes from.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help. Without topic - lists all operations.
